color_menus.description: If true, items in gopher menus are color coded according to item type using ANSI escape codes.

debug.description: If true, detailed debugging information is printed to stdout when commands are run.

encoding.description: Fallback text encoding to use if received gopher content cannot be decoded as UTF-8.

ipv6.description: If true, vf1 preferentially attempts to connect to gopher servers via IPv6 if a AAAA DNS record is found.

timeout.description: Time to wait, in seconds, when trying to connect to a gopher server before giving up.

handlers.description: List of MIME type handlers to configure persistent external programs for content presentation.

handlers.items.description: A single handler definition mapping a MIME type to a shell command.

handlers.items.mime_type.description: The MIME type or wildcard pattern (e.g., text/html, image/*) to match.

handlers.items.command.description: The shell command to execute, with %s replaced by the temporary file path.

initial_url.description: A Gopher URL to visit immediately upon startup. If empty, no initial navigation occurs.
